edges.reason: msg.sender/_msgSender() flows into _transfer as the source of funds, so caller identity drives transfer semantics.
block.timestamp is forwarded as the swap deadline, making execution dependent on miner-controlled time.
manualswap authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender to the development/marketing addresses.
manualsend authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender to the development/marketing addresses.
setTrading is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing _owner to _msgSender().
setFee is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
blockBots is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
unblockBot is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
allowPreTrading is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth to liquidate accrued tokens.
_transfer conditionally calls sendETHToFee after swapping.
_transfer delegates final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when no fee should be taken.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after a fee-free transfer.
_tokenTransfer performs the actual transfer via _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard forwards the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current rate.
_getRate derives supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection queries _getRate before dividing.
balanceOf converts the stored reflection balance with tokenFromReflection.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the ETH to the development address.
sendETHToFee transfers half of the ETH to the marketing address.
The constructor creates the Uniswap pair through the factory.
The constructor uses _msgSender() as the initial owner and initial reflection holder.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to enforce the transaction limit.
_transfer reads _maxWalletSize to enforce the wallet limit.
_transfer reads the bots blacklist for from/to.
_transfer reads tradingOpen to gate trading.
_transfer reads inSwap to avoid nested swaps.
_transfer reads swapEnabled before swapping.
_transfer writes the active redis fee based on buy/sell direction.
_transfer writes the active tax fee based on buy/sell direction.
setFee writes the buy redis fee.
setFee writes the buy tax fee.
setFee writes the sell redis fee.
setFee writes the sell tax fee.
blockBots writes true for each supplied address in the bots mapping.
unblockBot writes false for the supplied address in the bots mapping.
allowPreTrading writes the preTrader whitelist entry.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes the fee-exemption mapping.
The external router swap initiated from _transfer hands control to an untrusted contract before state finalization, enabling reentrancy on the transfer path.
ETH transfer to the development address occurs during the transfer flow and can execute recipient fallback code.
ETH transfer to the marketing address occurs during the transfer flow and can execute recipient fallback code.
manualswap triggers the external router swap, returning control to an untrusted router mid-call.
_getRValues multiplies token amounts by the rate, producing reflection values subject to arithmetic error.
_getTValues multiplies the amount by fee rates and divides by 100.
_transferStandard subtracts/ adds reflection amounts, affecting balances arithmetically.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_takeTeam multiplies the team amount by the rate.
removeAllFee saves and zeroes the active redis fee.
removeAllFee saves and zeroes the active tax fee.
restoreAllFee restores the saved redis fee.
restoreAllFee restores the saved tax fee.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned entries.
_takeTeam credits the contract's reflection balance.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal.
swapTokensForEth reads the router address and WETH path.
sendETHToFee reads the development address.
sendETHToFee reads the marketing address.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to classify buys and sells.
_approve writes the allowances mapping.
tokenFromReflection receives the reflection amount derived from _rOwned.
The from parameter of _transfer is the debit source.
The to parameter of _transfer is the credit destination.
The amount parameter of _transfer drives all accounting.
tokenAmount parameter is passed to the router swap.
amount parameter is split and transferred to fee recipients.
newOwner parameter is written into _owner after validation.
takeFee parameter decides whether fees are removed and restored.
tAmount parameter seeds the reflection computation chain.
contractTokenBalance local holds the contract balance used for swap decisions.
canSwap local gates the automatic swap branch.
takeFee local decides the fee branch in _transfer.

Array parameter is iterated to fill the blacklist mapping.
Address parameter is written to the blacklist mapping.
Threshold parameter writes the swap threshold state variable.
Flag parameter writes the swapEnabled state variable.
Amount parameter writes the maximum transaction limit.

Address parameter is validated then written into the owner state variable.
Amount parameter seeds the whole reflection computation chain.
Rate parameter multiplies the amounts to produce reflection values.
Team amount parameter is multiplied by the rate and credited to the contract.
Reflection amount parameter is divided by the current rate.
Flag parameter decides the fee removal/restoration branch.
Sender parameter is debited in the reflection ledger.
Recipient parameter is credited in the reflection ledger.
Local caches the contract balance to drive the swap branch.
Local boolean controls the automatic swap branch.
Local boolean controls fee application in the transfer path.
Local caches the rate used for the division.
Local swap path array is an argument of the router call.
Loop index is purely internal to the blacklist loop.
Cached sender is used to initialize owner and initial supply.
Local contract balance is passed to the swap helper.
Local ETH balance is passed to the fee distribution helper.
